description.narrative: Detta icke-öronmärkta stöd till UN Women Colombia’s Landplan (s.k.”Strategic Note”) bidrar till att stärka kvinnors politiska och ekonomiska egenmakt och till att skydda kvinnors rätt till ett liv utan våld, både inom och utanför konfliktkontexten, samtidigt som stödet bidrar till hållbar fred. UN Women har varit en strategisk partner för Sverige när det gäller att främja både jämställdhet och kvinnor, fred och säkerhetsagendan i Colombia i över 15 år. Denna insats är den andra icke-öronmärkta insatsen avtalad mellan Sida och UN Women Colombia (ID 55190037.

This unearmarked support to UN Women Colombia’s Strategic Note contributes to the strengthening of women’s political and economic empowerment and to protecting women’s right to a life free of violence, both within and beyond conflict contexts, while also contributing to sustainable peace. UN Women has been a strategic partner to Sweden in advancing both the gender equality and Women, Peace and Security agendas in Colombia for over 15 years, and this contribution is the second unearmarked contribution signed between Sida and UN Women Colombia (ID 55190037).

sector.narrative: Women’s rights organisations and movements, and government institutions

description.narrative:
Given that the contribution began its implementation in January 2024, no narrative reports have been submitted yet (activity period start 1 January 2024). Nevertheless, through the technical follow-up meetings and the strategic dialogues with UN Women, there is evidence that the implementation of the contribution is going according to the Annual Work Plan and the priorities established for 2024, in the areas of women, peace and security, public management, and women's leadership and political participation.
Some examples of results achieved to be highlighted are:
The contribution has strengthened the incorporation of a gender approach ins the investigations, victim's participation and reparations for crimes against women, with particular emphasis on sexual violence and GBV in the Special Jurisdiction for Peace (JEP in Spanish). In particular, the contribution has, among others: 1) supported women's organizations of victims of the armed conflict to participate in spaces for the construction of a diagnosis of priorities around strategic litigation, security guarantees and comprehensive accompaniment to victims led, in order to guide relevant and survivor-based strategic interventions; 2) accompanied The Special Jurisdiction for Peace (JEP) in its role as Technical Secretary of the Gender Technical Assistance Board (MATG) so that women's and victims' organizations continue to carry out advocacy and dialogue actions with the SIPAZ institutions (JEP and UBPD) on the inclusion of the gender approach. In 2024 in particular, women's advocacy and input was accompanied in the framework of the discussion on reparations, the process of updating the Victims' Participation Manual, and the generation of recommendations on restoration with a gender perspective.
Sweden has contributed to the work for the participative elaboration of the National Action Plan for the Implementation of the United Nation's Security Council Resolution 1325 on Women, Peace and Security (NAP1325), which was approved by the Government of Colombia in November 2024. The implementation of the NAP1325 in the territories is one of the priorities established for 2025.
